Name: Smiling Krobus
Author: UpsetSaturn
Description:
Whenever I went and talked to Krobus I always felt bad as he never really seemed too happy (probably due to him living in the Sewer) so I decided to give his portrait and sprite a bit of a smile.

Installation: Simply drag the 'Content' folder into your Stardew Valley folder (typically 'SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley')

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
